mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 40 degrees with overcast skies at Verona Area High School, and please note the ISS will be passing overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
The Plan Commission will review several projects, including the Sub-Zero site plan on December 7th, and the city has posted official notices for the upcoming election cycle.

Today, you can join a yoga session at Insight Wellness or enjoy the ART House 360 night. Looking ahead, Hop Haus Trivia is happening tomorrow, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and the Dane County Farmers Market on November 14th.
In a report from the Verona Police Department, officers responded to a domestic disturbance on Church Avenue on Wednesday, October 21st.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Devil's Food Cake, and you can stop by Culver's anytime before they close at 10:00 PM.
